post.summary: Add new consumer during login sequence
post.description: Register one consumer in the system during logging sequence. Send email and pwd in an array called rows.

put.description:
Update a consumer with new access and refresh tokens (used for login with token and token refresh).

**IMPORTANT:** This endpoint requires valid tokens from a previous login. You must:
1. First call POST /consumers to login and receive real tokens
2. Copy the accessToken and refreshToken from the login response
3. Use those exact tokens in both the Authorization header and request body
4. The tokens are validated against the cache - fake tokens will fail with 401

delete.description: Delete a consumer from the system (used when logging out). Requires JWT access token in Authorization header.
